| BUG-09 | `src/storage.py` → `unique_names` | Reuses/shadows the loop variable `name` in the inner comprehension. |
| BUG-10 | `src/storage.py` → `safe_last` | Uses `items[len(items)]`, which is out of bounds; should use a bounds-checked index. |
